subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
The position and positional values or English Alphabets are:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5377e84ec2217ffbf24433e93b5b95deae32db46b1c995804c5f903f872db96.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

Each letter-cluster follows the pattern +5, -6.

Let's check each option:

1. QVP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f83cc9346da68125798a9b0269b95a5790e5fc4b1ad9c24b9210d6ed04aa7945.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +5, -6.

2. MRL

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe6edcfce5a0ab017bc919cc6074511938bc54d27a6e1e487e3e99690fdef726.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +5, -6.

3. EJD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a1f0a947c35875dfa812e20cc54814353ba70a9e5b8fd36c5e012a4223a6c0b.png] 

This letter-cluster follows the pattern +5, -6.

4. TYR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9665e3dd77a0509a91295b728327e6fcc554ce51e600860440019e8233870750.png] 

This letter-cluster does not follows the pattern +5, -6.

Thus, TYR is the odd one out.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
